re:current_analytics Playground · Forecast

Forecast

Three crews, one small town, and weather you can see coming. Until you can't.

  • Keep the town alive for 3 years. One house is one person.
  • Tinted ground is next round's weather. Flashing houses will be lost.
  • Tap a crew, tap where it walks, tap where it works. Then end the round.
All the rules

Three years of five rounds. Each round you see what the weather will do next, in this order:

stormtakes 1 person in every quarter along half a row, and knocks down trees and levees there
heattakes 1 person per quarter in its square, unless a tree stands on one of the 8 tiles around the quarter
floodspreads from a stretch of the river, tile by tile, and takes 1 person in every quarter it reaches

Each crew walks up to 3 tiles (not across the river; tap the crew itself to stay), then works once on one of the 4 tiles beside it:

Ssandbags: on open ground a levee that stops one flood and is then washed away; on a quarter, it keeps the flood out this round
Ttrees: plants a tree, which keeps the quarters around it cool
Eshelter: the quarter it stands on or beside loses no one this round

Between years people move back: every quarter that still has people grows by one, up to 4. In year 2 the forecast gives ranges: speckled ground and a ? may or may not be hit. And year 3? Watch closely.

Keys: arrows and Enter on the map, S T E pick a crew, U undo, N end round, M sound, ? this page.
